Option Explicit
Private Function DoCase(ByVal target As String, ByVal member As String, ByVal flag As Variant, ByVal scenario As Long) As String
    Dim obj As Object
    Dim result As Variant
    Dim savedNumber As Long
    ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).Name = "Sheet1"
    Range("A1").Value = ""
    Range("B1").Value = "payload"
    Select Case target
    Case "Range"
        Set obj = Range("A1")
    Case "Worksheet"
        Set obj = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
    Case "Workbook"
        Set obj = ThisWorkbook
    Case "Collection"
        Set obj = New Collection
        obj.Add "one"
    Case "Err"
        Set obj = Err
    End Select
    Err.Clear
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case scenario
    Case 0
        result = CallByName(obj, member, flag)
    Case 1
        result = CallByName(obj, member, flag, "x")
    Case 2
        result = CallByName(obj, member, flag, Range("B1"))
    Case 3
        result = CallByName(obj, member, flag, 1, "x")
    End Select
    savedNumber = Err.Number
    DoCase = CStr(savedNumber) & "~" & TypeName(result) & "~" & CStr(Range("A1").Value)
End Function

    Dim obj As Object

    ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).Name = "Sheet1"
    Range("A1").Value = ""
    Range("B1").Value = "payload"
    Select Case target
    Case "Range"
        Set obj = Range("A1")

        Set obj = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1)

        Set obj = ThisWorkbook
    Case "Collection"
        Set obj = New Collection
        obj.Add "one"
    Case "Err"
        Set obj = Err
    End Select
    Err.Clear
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case scenario
    Case 0
        result = CallByName(obj, member, flag)
    Case 1
        result = CallByName(obj, member, flag, "x")

        result = CallByName(obj, member, flag, "10", "x")

Option Explicit
Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim obj As New Item
    Dim result As Variant
    Dim report As String
    Dim n As Long
    Dim dict As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    CallByName obj, "Choice", VbLet, "x"
    report = "optional_let=" & CStr(Err.Number) & "~" & obj.Trace & vbLf
    Err.Clear
    CallByName obj, "Choice", VbSet, "x"
    report = report & "optional_set=" & CStr(Err.Number) & "~" & obj.Trace & vbLf
    Err.Clear
    CallByName obj, "Choice", VbLet, 2, "x"
    report = report & "explicit_let=" & CStr(Err.Number) & "~" & obj.Trace & vbLf
    Err.Clear
    n = 40
    CallByName obj, "Touch", VbMethod, n
    report = report & "byref_copyback=" & CStr(Err.Number) & "~" & CStr(n) & vbLf
    Err.Clear
    Range("C1").Value = "Choice"
    Range("D1").Value = 2.6
    result = CallByName(obj, Range("C1"), Range("D1"))
    report = report & "object_name_kind=" & CStr(Err.Number) & "~" & CStr(result) & vbLf
    Err.Clear
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Range("A1").Value = "payload"
    CallByName dict, "Item", VbLet, "one", Range("A1")
    report = report & "dictionary_object=" & CStr(Err.Number) & "~" & TypeName(dict.Item("one")) & vbLf
    Probe = report
End Function
